title: Screen map
description: Structured description of the mobile app's navigation surface, produced by extract_screen_map.py. Consumed by generate_draft_flow.py to produce a baseline Maestro flow without LLM involvement.

bundle_id_android.description: Android applicationId from app.json / app.config (`android.package`). Null if the app does not target Android.

bundle_id_ios.description: iOS bundle identifier (`ios.bundleIdentifier`). Null if the app does not target iOS.

entry_screen.description: Filesystem path (relative to workspace) of the first screen the user lands on after splash. For Expo Router, typically `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` or `app/index.tsx`.

label_guess.description: Best guess at the tab's visible label, used to drive maestro tapOn.

icon_name.description: Inferred icon name when one was detected, used as a fallback selector.

dynamic.description: True for `[id]`-style dynamic Expo Router segments.

login_screen.description: Workspace-relative file path of the screen judged to be the login screen.

indicators.description: Plain-English hints that drove the detection (e.g. "TextInput with placeholder 'Email'").

email_field_label.description: Most likely on-screen label / placeholder for the email/username input.

password_field_label.description: Most likely on-screen label / placeholder for the password input.

submit_label.description: Most likely on-screen label for the submit button (e.g. "Sign in").

items.description: Workspace-relative file path of a screen judged to be scrollable (contains ScrollView/FlatList/FlashList/SectionList).

has_demo_mode_flag.description: True if the workspace contains a documented demo / fixture mode the audit can opt into (`__DEV__` toggle, env var like EXPO_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE, etc.).

extraction_warnings.description: Non-fatal heuristic failures during extraction. Surfaced internally; never appears in the report.
